pageInfo.overview: A public-information proof-of-concept of the firm’s causal pathways. The pages are deliberately shaped differently to match their domains.
pageInfo.p1: Client needs and trust form a short diagnostic-to-mandate pathway.
pageInfo.p2: Commissioning expands into scope, methods, governance and commercial terms before mobilisation.
pageInfo.p3: Evidence branches into specialist analyses and reconverges through triangulation and explicit uncertainty.
pageInfo.p4: Strategy, policy and investment disciplines converge into prioritised, decision-ready advice.
pageInfo.p5: Implementation requires distinct readiness, design, organisation, execution, adoption and benefit stages.
pageInfo.p6: Evaluation is designed as a learning loop that changes future action.
pageInfo.p7: Responsible AI delivery depends on a narrow human-accountability bottleneck.
pageInfo.p8: People, culture, quality, feedback, ethics and innovation combine into firm resilience.
pageInfo.p9: Level 1 How Page: client delivery workstreams. Mapping is deferred to Step 2.
pageInfo.p10: Level 2 How Page: functions and leadership. Mapping is deferred to Step 2.

docContent.p12:
Purpose

This proof-of-concept board models how MartinJenkins may create value: moving from client needs and trusted mandates through evidence, advice, implementation, evaluation and organisational stewardship to lasting impact.

Scope

The board covers publicly described consulting and advisory services, client groups, values, quality practices and AI-enabled delivery. It is an external analytical model, not an internal strategy, operating plan, organisation chart or assurance review.

Assumptions

  • The firm seeks impact through trusted advice and practical implementation support.
  • Different service disciplines share an integrated evidence and quality pathway.
  • Client ownership, partnership and engagement are necessary for lasting change.
  • People, senior involvement and quality control underpin delivery resilience.

Sources

The structure draws on MartinJenkins public pages for its story, services, client groups, impact and AI-enabled solutions. Source URLs are available in the board Sources registry.

Cautions and limitations

Public website material describes the firm’s offer but does not disclose internal economics, strategic priorities, project data, client-confidential work or all causal dependencies. Labels and links are hypotheses for human review. Current facts should be rechecked before operational use.
docContent.p13:
Illustrative approach

Use a small balanced set of indicators and evaluation questions. Agree definitions, baselines, owners, cadence and disaggregation with MartinJenkins before use. Measures should support decisions rather than create reporting burden.

Example measure

Example evaluation question

Example outcome box

Cadence

  • Monthly: delivery, quality, workload and emerging risk review.
  • At project gates: scope, evidence quality, stakeholder participation and recommendation readiness.
  • Quarterly: client feedback, portfolio, capability and innovation review.
  • Annually: strategic outcomes, firm resilience and contribution to Aotearoa review.

Learning use

Interpret quantitative trends with client, staff and stakeholder evidence. Record unintended effects, distributional impacts and uncertainty. Convert findings into named improvement decisions and revisit them in the next cycle.
